From the shelf (one entry, docs.saltmarsh.example/limits, read 2026-08-21):

  Hosted runners: job cancelled after 6 hours; whole pipeline run after 72 hours.
  Jobs queued more than 24 hours are dropped.
  Self-hosted runners: no job time limit.

Your 7-hour nightly job would be killed at 6h on a hosted runner. Two ways around it:

  - Run it on a self-hosted runner (no job limit).
  - Split it into two or more sequential jobs each under 6h; the 72h pipeline limit leaves plenty of room.

Caveat: that fact is from August docs and I have not re-verified it against the current version — the workspace (/stand/ws) has no Saltmarsh config, so there is nothing local to confirm which runner type you would use. Worth a quick re-read of the limits page before you commit the job design.
